BUG: Race condition in pagination. DiscoverScreen.kt LaunchedEffect (line 95-98) triggers LoadNextPage when isNearEnd becomes true without preventing concurrent requests. If user scrolls quickly, multiple LoadNextPage intents fire before previous completes, causing currentPage to increment multiple times and skipping pages or loading duplicates. Fix: Add a loading flag or debounce the pagination trigger.
CODE QUALITY: Unused import in DiscoverScreen.kt line 19. 'androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll' is imported but never used. Remove unused import.

CODE QUALITY: Pagination logic tightly coupled to hardcoded page size. DiscoverViewModel and GetDiscoverFeedUseCase determine hasMore via 'papers.size == 4' without explicit page size constant. Extract PAGE_SIZE as a named constant and pass it explicitly for clarity and maintainability.
